thread:
sara.sales: Heads-up — POC customer is seeing truncation of older messages, they say the assistant "lost context" after ~20 turns. Error shown to them: `400 Bad Request: max_input_tokens exceeded`.

toni.engineer: Which API did they call? generation or chat-stream?

sara.sales: Chat endpoint, single request with full message array + 2 inline screenshots (base64). payload ~2.5MB.

liam-devex: `max_input_tokens` is enforced at the runtime; default cap for hosted is 16384 tokens. If they build large message arrays with attachments encoded inline, tokens + body size blow up.

julia-sre: runtime logs show: `runtime: reject request, cause="sequence length 23745 > max 16384" org=org_R7`. Gateway accepted it, runtime rejected.

rafael-ps: Customer's note: "we need raw chat to preserve instruction context; summarization changed behavior." They're worried about model hallucinating after truncation.

toni.engineer: Immediate mitigation options: (A) set `truncate: "tail"` so older turns are trimmed server-side, (B) reduce `max_input_tokens` client-side to a safe value and rely on a local summarizer, (C) move attachments off-request and pass image urls.

liam-devex: Example client-side chunking/summarization snippet I sent them earlier:

```
// pseudo
const history = loadHistory();
const summary = summarizeOlderTurns(history.slice(0, -10));
const payload = { messages: [summary, ...history.slice(-10)] };
post('/v1/chat', payload);
```

julia-sre: For this POC we can temporarily raise the runtime token cap for org_R7 to 32768 tokens on a dedicated test runtime, but it requires billing approval and an ops ticket. Ops-bot: create request?

ops-bot: ticket #1021 created for limit increase request, assigned to infra-ops, status: awaiting-approval :rotating_light: 

toni.engineer: Note on cost/pricing: doubling token cap doubles potential per-request token consumption. Sales should confirm they understand token pricing impact and worst-case estimate.

sara.sales: Will confirm pricing with customer. Also they asked whether Private deployment (VPC) lets them keep full raw history — answer?

liam-devex: Private/dedicated can be configured with higher sequence limits and custom runtime params, yes. But that moves to a different SKU and SLA. Mention compliance + egress implications if images referenced externally.

rafael-ps: I'll draft an email: short-term recommended config + exact SDK params + cost delta. Include example summarization pipeline and prefer external image hosting.

toni.engineer: Also remind them of `truncate: "head"` option if they prefer preserving the start of conversation instead of the tail.

sara.sales: Thanks — action plan: rafael to send recommended mitigations + sample code, ops to follow ticket #1021, liam to provide rough cost delta numbers. I'll update customer after I have answers. :thumbsup:

rafael-ps: Drafted and sent. Customer replied asking for a live walkthrough tomorrow.
